desc: Implement a helper class or function to maintain the sliding window median and cost using two heaps with lazy removal.
Precompute an array `cost[i]` which stores the minimum operations to make `nums[i:i+x]` all equal, for all valid `i`.
Initialize a DP table `dp[k+1][n+1]` with infinity, setting `dp[0][0] = 0`.

Iterate through the array, updating the DP table: for each position `i` from 1 to n, and for each count `j` from 1 to k, update `dp[j][i]` by considering skipping the current element or forming a subarray ending at `i-1` if `i >= x`.
